hinge_axis_review: Two original cylindrical moving hinge barrels at source z about -0.621 m and x about 0.031 m locate the revolute axis; they are vertically separated. Their 15 mm scaled width exceeds the generic outer-edge proxy, so use their measured centers without relaxing its 10 mm center check.
unlatched_review: Component 10 is the small projecting latch tongue at the handle-side edge (source z 0.615-0.637 m, y 1.239-1.292 m). The task starts closed and unlatched; keep its visual mesh, omit only its collider. Components 4-5 are the moving edge/lock plate and remain collidable, as do the leaf, frame, handles and hinges.
modifications: Select the source closed Null door/frame assembly from an USDZ that also displays a spatially separate open duplicate Null_1; preserve the original USDZ, all selected meshes, UVs and four maps.
Uniform 0.75 scale, proper Y-up to Z-up rotation and floor-centered opening. Source hinge at negative width maps to left-handed canonical push with no reflection.
Infer the ideal revolute joint from the two original moving hinge barrels. Original viewer animation is not used for B1 push control.
Begin closed and already unlatched: retain the original latch tongue visual but omit only its collision, with all other contact meshes retained.

Declare the reviewed central aperture above the modeled bottom corner and below the rebated header; this preserves the frame sill and corner geometry rather than treating the full leaf bounds as empty passage.
Uniform 2% moving-assembly fit, including all handle and hinge visuals/colliders, around opening center and mid-height to resolve measured source edge/hinge crossings.
Partition the existing frame collider at canonical width Y ±0.445 m and height Z 0.095/1.993 m to represent the modeled corner rebates while retaining all frame collision and visual geometry.

Use one convex outer-envelope collider for leaf 14 because default PhysX cooking omitted 5.3 mm of its bottom skin; this preserves its visual/collision bounds and full solid push surface while approximating decorative window recesses.
review_notes: Inspect attempt 000002 on the selected local USDC identifies leaf 14, frame 19, bars/window/edge/hinges 4-13 and paired lever/escutcheon hardware 0-3,15-18.
The initial recipe keeps source dimensions and colliders; any clearance fit or frame partitions require a demonstrated normalized gate failure.

Attempt 000003 obstructed the full-leaf rectangular aperture because corner/threshold frame hulls occupy its lower 49 mm and upper 49 mm; the actual central opening remains 0.890 x 1.898 m, over 90% of the leaf footprint.
Direct convex analysis with the measured frame partition and 2% fit clears the closed pose and predicts a limited geometric opening; no threshold angle is imposed or tuned.

Static attempt 000005 measured panel visual lower bound Z=0.06442 m versus cooked collider Z=0.06974 m, beyond the 2 mm gate. A direct convex-envelope check retains the same 23.1-degree geometric stop without disabling collisions.
clearance_review: Attempt 000004 witnesses original-surface intersections of moving edge plate 5 and hinge barrels 6/8 with the fixed frame 19; default cooked leaf/frame corner hulls also overlap. A uniform 2% Panel/Handle fit around the opening center and 1.05 m height reduces the protruding edge and hinge hardware by about 9 mm per side. Direct closed-hull analysis after this fit removes all edge/hinge intersections. The frame is partitioned at its measured corner/central aperture boundaries without moving or deleting source surfaces; it clears remaining cooked-hull corner overlap. No collision tolerance is relaxed. The geometric opening limit is determined by the actual sweep, not a desired angle.
